metadata.scan_summary: Comprehensive scan of all .cs, .cshtml, .config, and .json files found zero raw SQL statements. The application uses Entity Framework 6 LINQ queries exclusively for all data access operations. No DMS MCP tool conversion or SQL Equivalency validation was required.
search_patterns_used: Inline SQL keywords: SELECT, INSERT INTO, UPDATE...SET, DELETE FROM, EXEC, CREATE TABLE, ALTER TABLE, DROP TABLE
String-based SQL patterns: quoted SQL keywords in string literals
ADO.NET classes: SqlCommand, SqlConnection, SqlDataReader, SqlParameter
EF raw SQL methods: ExecuteSqlCommand, FromSqlRaw, FromSqlInterpolated, Database.SqlQuery
Stored procedure patterns: StoredProcedure, CommandType.StoredProcedure, sp_, usp_
StringBuilder SQL patterns: StringBuilder with SQL, CommandText, CommandType
SQL Server connection strings: Data Source=, Server=...Database=, Initial Catalog
metadata.data_access_patterns_found: All data access uses Entity Framework 6 LINQ queries (Where, Take, FirstOrDefault, ToList, SingleOrDefault, Single, Sum, Add, Remove, SaveChanges)
